name: Mid East Portfolio Management Limited
about: Mid East Portfolio Management Limited provides investment services to NRIs in India. The company offers various services, such as portfolio management, new issue, and stock broking services/online trading facilities demat services. It also provides equity placement services; and life insurance, general insurance, travel insurance, and health insurance. In addition, the company invest in mutual fund, saving schemes, RIB, and india millennium development bonds. Mid East Portfolio Management Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
